name: Master Kush
summary: Master Kush is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] from [[breeder:White Label]], the seed line sold through [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]], bred from two [[hindu-kush|Hindu Kush]] landrace lines. Sensi gives their origins as India and Afghanistan. It won gold at the High Life Cannabis Cup in Utrecht in 2004.

sources.title: Master Kush (feminized)
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms White Label, two Hindu Kush indicas from India and Afghanistan, the 2004 Utrecht High Life Cup gold, and 50–55 days of flowering.
